items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know what you playing, Connor?

ctx.x: I'm gonna want you to go down the bridge way with me.
You know what you playing, Connor?
I said, yeah, come on. He got in the truck and went down that way. I was surprised. I'm telling you, he was playing just like Chris Kelly. Yeah. Mm-hmm. Yeah.
